name: helpdesk-app
description: Helpdesk: a small 4-service microservice app used as the subject of a DevOps project

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix services/auth-service install && npm --prefix services/ticket-service install && npm --prefix services/notification-service install && npm --prefix services/frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n auth,tickets,notify,web -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm --prefix services/auth-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/ticket-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/notification-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix services/auth-service test && npm --prefix services/ticket-service test && npm --prefix services/notification-service test
